items.reply: I change to TP/nit. GroupPermissionsV2.java:121–125 performs per-resource permission checks, but V1 already uses the same loop and evaluation mechanism, including separate decision caches. The global-view guard and iteration over authorization resources limit the affected work; linear evaluation alone does not establish a meaningful performance defect. Batching is an optimisation suggestion, and my earlier classification overstated the demonstrated impact.
